messages:
maria_support: FYI — customer (ACME Industries) hit a payment failure on invoice #INV-54631. They attached a PO but Stripe returned a tax/VAT mismatch error. Customer is asking for Net45 approval while we sort billing. Can someone take?
priya_sales: cc @jordan_finance — they say the PO number is 2023-ACME-77 but our invoice shows VAT ID GB999999999. Customer claims their VAT is GB999999998 (off by one). They want access to service; asking if we can provision while finance verifies.
jordan_finance: @maria_support thanks — I see the invoice was generated with the VAT ID from the contract template. We need docs to change VAT. For provisional access we can do a one-week temporary credit (manual override) if sales signs off. Is the customer asking Net45 permanently or just for this cycle?
maria_support: They requested Net45 as standard terms going forward (they have internal PO cycles). For this month they asked if we can keep services live immediately.
priya_sales: I can sign off provisional credit for one week. But legal may need to confirm VAT ID change before we alter invoice. @legal_ops any objections?
legal_ops: No objection to provisional credit given amount <$25k. For VAT ID change we need scanned VAT cert + confirmation email from purchasing. Also need PO to match billing contact.
invoices-bot: Invoice INV-54631 status: payment_failed (card_decline), error: "tax_id_mismatch". Retry available after update.
leo_engineer: tagging for context — customer reported API timeouts earlier this morning but that looks separate (we were having increased latency in eu-west-1). Not tied to billing but worth noting for churn risk.
jordan_finance: Steps I'd recommend: 1) ask customer to upload VAT cert + confirmation (email ok). 2) Sales to approve 1-week provisional credit and create escalation note. 3) Finance to update VAT ID on invoice after docs, then trigger retry/payment. If card was declined we may need manual capture.
maria_support: I'll send a templated request to customer now with required docs and set expectation: we can enable provisional access for 7 days after Priya confirms. Copying the exact text here: "Please reply with scanned VAT registration certificate and the purchaser's confirmation email matching PO 2023-ACME-77. Once received, we can update invoice and retry payment"
priya_sales: Approved — I sign provisional credit. :thumbsup: @jordan_finance please mark in Salesforce (deal 7432) and set net_terms = 45 if finance approves after docs.
jordan_finance: Will do. Also noting: if they want Net45 long-term we need master agreement amendment signed. Please escalate for legal to draft addendum.
legal_ops: I'll prepare a short addendum template and DM Priya. For now, provisional access OK.
maria_support: Customer replied with VAT cert (attached) at 1919004602 and confirmation email at 1919004620. Forwarding to finance.
invoices-bot: Payment retry scheduled after invoice update.
jordan_finance: Updated VAT to GB999999998 and queued payment retry at 1919004800. If retry fails due to card decline, ask customer for alternate payment method or supply wire instructions.
maria_support: Noted. I'll keep thread open and update if retry fails. Thanks everyone for quick responses.
priya_sales: Heads up — mentioned possible Net45 term; I'll follow up on signed addendum once legal shares template.
maria_support: closing loop for now — last action: finance retry at 1919004800. Will reopen if payment fails. :white_check_mark:
